cost_notes: train_wall_seconds includes TUNE checkpoint inference and checkpoint writes, not pure optimizer time
latency includes raw missing-value forward-fill/normalization and inverse normalization; model load/disk read excluded
VRAM and RSS refer to co-resident benchmark process; not isolated method-exclusive footprint
ridge fits are float64; published predictions and timed corrections use mathematically equivalent float32 effective coefficients with measured conversion differences
REC and PRED both select E/D on TUNE physical MSE through Bolt, so choosing checkpoint0 is valid and recorded
PCA native runs only seed92601; nonlinear REC/PRED each run both seeds; PCA repeated codec controls at REC selected0 are intentionally retained
